entities.name: Porter H. Dale
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Porter Hinman Dale was an American educator, lawyer, and politician who served as a member of both the United States House of Representatives from 1915 to 1923, and the United States Senate from Vermont from 1923 to 1933.
